analysis: The trial completed successfully but achieved host macro validation HR@10 of 0.5637, down 0.0100 from the 0.5737 reference. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.625, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.590, Electronics 0.380, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.660. Compared with the supplied reference category results, Electronics improved slightly from 0.375, while CDs_and_Vinyl fell from 0.700. Category-specific fusion therefore did not improve the overall host result. Grid selection guarantees nondecrease versus equal fusion only on the same frozen checkpoints and local validation cases. Selected weights, local grid metrics, and checkpoint comparisons were not supplied, so the regression cannot be attributed conclusively to fusion selection or training variation.
code_summary: Retains independent per-category SASRec and MultVAE experts. SASRec combines causal attention with a gated prefix-preference representation and trains using cross-entropy over one positive and 64 negatives. MultVAE reconstructs binary user histories with an annealed KL penalty. Each expert checkpoint is selected independently by validation HR@10 with an NDCG tie-break. Frozen checkpoints produce cached validation candidate ranks; reciprocal-rank fusion uses constant 60 and selects a SASRec weight from {0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1}, breaking hit-count ties by proximity to 0.5, then smaller weight. Metadata saves weights and grid results; the generated predictor loads the matching category checkpoints and saved fusion weight. All four dataset routes and single-GPU execution remain intact.
